INTELLIGENCE ROADMAP

BUILD IN PHASES
01 / PRIME AWARD SCANNER

Live USAspending search, source links, identifiers, pagination, and device-local alert rules.

02 / COMPANY IDENTITY

Available: exact-UEI company grouping and browser watchlists. Available: SEC issuer ticker/CIK directory matches. Next: CAGE, award-recipient ownership mapping and durable contract histories.

03 / SUPPLIER NETWORK

Available: reported subaward search and prime-award tracing. Next: supplier announcements and relationship history.

04 / GROWTH & IPO EVIDENCE

Available: selected-prime transaction histories and 30/90/365-day net-obligation comparisons. Next: company-wide comparisons. Review company scale, revenue, funded backlog, S-1/F-1 filings and expansion.

05 / SOCIAL & BACKGROUND ALERTS

Accessible X/social sources, official company announcements, Available: hourly local headline collection, duplicate retrieval suppression and persistent research alerts. Next: authorized social feeds, event clustering and continuous hosting.
